title: Opus 5 (1M) vs GPT-6 Astra - GCP Multi-tenant Terraform
effort: default (both arms headless, no effort directive)
headline: Tied 74/75 on every objective build check after one repair pass; GPT-6 Astra wins 98-88.5 on the cross-review round (15 verified findings vs 3) and on the blast-radius criterion. Opus 5 was 2.4x slower and 6.5x the output tokens on the build; cost is reported for Opus only ($16.37 across three rounds) because Codex CLI reports none.
